footerNote: Net income here is Palantir's total net income of $106M; $105.5M of it is attributable to common stockholders (the remaining $0.5M belongs to noncontrolling interests). Segment figures are from the segment note in Palantir's Q1 2024 Form 10-Q. Palantir reports in thousands; figures are rounded to whole $M and tie exactly to reported totals with no line adjusted beyond normal rounding — other income is shown as $30M (reported net $29.8M: $43.4M of interest income less $13.5M of other expense).
otherDetail: Interest income of $43.4M on Palantir's cash pile, less $13.5M of other expense, net — mainly realized and unrealized losses on equity securities and foreign-currency moves — a net +$29.8M below operating profit, shown as $30M rounded.

segments.name: Government
segments.note: Software for governments, above all the U.S. military and intelligence agencies — U.S. government revenue grew 12% YoY to $257M.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.note: Software for companies — U.S. commercial revenue jumped 40% to $150M as the AIP 'bootcamp' push kept winning customers, and the U.S. commercial customer count grew 69% to 262.

takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue grew 40% YoY to $150M, the U.S. commercial customer count grew 69% to 262, and U.S. commercial remaining deal value grew 74%.
takeaways.title: U.S. business customers surged

takeaways.text: GAAP net income was $106M — a 17% margin — with GAAP operating income of $81M, a 13% margin, and GAAP EPS of $0.04, up from $0.01 a year ago.
takeaways.title: Sixth straight profitable quarter

takeaways.text: Adjusted free cash flow was $149M — 23 cents of every revenue dollar — with $3.9B of cash and short-term U.S. Treasury securities on hand, a Rule of 40 score of 57%, and Palantir raised full-year revenue guidance to $2.677–$2.689B.
takeaways.title: Cash generation and a higher outlook

verdict: Palantir grew revenue 21% to $634M as U.S. commercial sales jumped 40% on AI demand, and kept $106M as profit — its sixth straight profitable quarter — while raising its full-year outlook.
